query: Bank ne galat charge deduct kar liya 4500 rupees aur bol rahe hain system error hai par reverse nahi kar rahe 2 mahine se.

model_output.summary: Aapke bank account se 4,500 rupees galat tarike se deduct kar liye gaye hain aur bank ise 2 mahine se reverse nahi kar raha hai, jise consumer law ke tahat banking services mein 'deficiency in service' mana ja sakta hai.
facts_extracted: Bank ne 4500 rupees galat charge ke roop mein deduct kiye hain
Bank ise system error bata raha hai par 2 mahine se paise wapas nahi kiye
Dispute ki amount 50 lakh rupees se kam hai

options.title: Bank ke Nodal Officer / Grievance Cell mein Shikayat karein
options.description: Sabse pehle bank ke branch manager ya official customer grievance portal par written complaint darj karein ki system error ke chalte aapke paise galat kate hain.
pros: Court jaane ki zaroorat nahi padti
cons: Agar bank na mane toh waqt lag sakta hai

options.title: Banking Ombudsman ya Consumer Forum mein Shikayat
options.description: Agar bank 2 mahine se solution nahi de raha hai, toh aap Consumer Protection Act ke tahat District Consumer Commission mein deficiency in service ke liye shikayat darj kar sakte hain.
pros: Kanooni taur par paise wapas aur compensation milne ka rasta

citations.relevance: Aap bank ki services 'avail' kar rahe hain, isliye aap is Act ke tahat ek 'Consumer' hain.
Bank dwara galat charge kaatna aur 2 mahine tak reverse na karna banking service mein 'deficiency' (kami) kahlata hai.
